summary: Datavault AI Inc. filed a prospectus supplement (424B5) for a registered direct offering of 109,090,910 shares of common stock at $0.55 per share, aiming to raise $60M gross. Titan Partners Group LLC serves as sole placement agent, receiving $4.2M in fees and warrants. The offering is a standard equity capital raise, not a special situation. Shares trade on Nasdaq under DVLT. This is a routine at-the-market-like registered direct offering to limited purchasers, with no acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring components. The filing is purely a capital markets transaction, warranting no special-situation classification.
